description:
You will create 5 shapes of homemade fresh pasta in a "Antica Osteria" founded in the late 1800s and recently converted into cooking school. You will taste your own pasta, with two different kind of italian fresh sauce, created and explained by the chef, immersed in a magical atmosphere between past and present.
You will make the thin dough sheet with the rolling pin professional technique,safe food cutting procedures, realization of tortellini, cappellacci, ravioli, agnolotti del plin, fettuccine and more. The experience includes a delicious tasting of local cheese or homemade. Tasting our different kind of pasta, sipping good italian wine, an express tiramisu preparation will follow as a dessert. Moreover, to all the participants will be offered complimentary, the exclusive Professional Chef Hat with logo of "Pastificio Faini" and also the apron with logo.
HACCP Certified for Food Hygiene and Safety in 2020
hostdescription:
I am chef and professional pasta maker. My parents worked in their "pasta factory" for 40 years making pasta with passion. Author of the book "Faini Method" in which I created an infallible method on how to make pasta.
I have also been reviewed in the prestigious guide "Il Gambero Rosso" since 2017.
I was inspired by the "magical" pasta made by my grandmother when I was a child and I am so proud to teach everyone how to make this special pasta.
HACCP Certified for Food Hygiene and Safety in 2020
locationDescription: The Osteria is a old public place in which wine is mainly served and, in some cases, food and snacks. This one was, after long time and different destinations during the years, come back to the world of food. We have renovated keeping all the original materials like the columns, arches, ceilings and the amazing original fireplace. Today you can feel the atmosphere of the past in a modern setting cooking school.

reviews.text: Such a nice experience, the hosts were very happy to give us the course and made the experience very fun. There was music when we were cooking, and during the lessons it was explained very well that it will be easy to cook again at home. At the end we ate our pastas (raviolli), and some fettucini cacio e pepe, with a tiramitsu. We also drank proscecco and red wine. I thought the price was very cheap considering all you get from the experience. Definitely recommand.

Highly recommend this experience! We are grateful to know how to make pasta from the experts! Both chefs are very warm and welcoming, patient and funny. We enjoyed every bit of the story during the class. They paid close attention to everyone in the group and made sure we learned how to make authentic Italian pasta (the real deal) and had fun doing it. We also enjoyed the wine they served during and after the class! Definitely book this experience!

A must do if you are in Rome. Emanuele and his team did a great job putting together this class in a fun way for everyone. It was a great experience making pasta together as a group and Emanuele made sure we were entertained the whole time.
Emanuele’s cooking class was the perfect experience for a trip to Rome. His teaching style made it easy for us to remember how to make everything back at home. Would highly highly recommend!

Emanuele and his team were great and accommodative hosts (we ended up doing an entirely vegetarian class which was hard for us to find anywhere else)! We cooked in their newly renovated kitchen which was nice and spacious even with a big group of 12 people. Emanuele’s warm personality made it a perfect environment to learn and cook in. He also provided everyone with typed notes at the end so you don’t need to worry about remembering every single detail for when you try to make more pasta at home. Incredible value and a highlight of our trip!

The pasta lesson was very professional. It gives practical tools for making pasta. The amount of pasta is completely sufficient, plus you get a very tasty dessert. The general atmosphere is very pleasant and the chefs are constantly smiling and nice. And there is personal attention, good music and wine, we enjoyed ourselves very much, highly.

Emanuele and Angelo have this experience down perfectly! They were such hospitable hosts and the experience was simplified for my wife and i who have never made pasta before. Its perfect for couples and groups or even if you are solo! I would 100% book this experience again. And to top it off, the meal was amazing!
My friend and I had the best time with Emanuele and Angelo. It was the perfect experience to cap off our time in Italy- highly recommend for anyone looking for a unique and incredibly fun time!

The cooking class was beyond anything I could imagine ! Everything was so light and fun ! The explanations were great, and we always had help if we needed it from Emanuele who’s the nicest person
It exceeded my expectations and I would 100% recommend !

Once in a life experience. Hands on doing pasta, what could be better, eating the pasta which you do 😋😋
Emanuele and Angelo are superb teachers, fun, lively and encouraging 🤗🤗
It is highly recomended.

Amazing, beautiful experience that I would recommand to anyone coming to Rome. Insted of standing hours to see the most overrated tourist attractions, it is so much better to spend an afternoon with Emanuele. Really five stars experience!

This was the favourite part of our trip to Rome! Strangely was the tour I was unsure about booking as I’ve always been terrible at pasta making but I am sooo incredibly glad I did! Nothing about it was intimidating, Emanuel, Angelo and the other kitchen staff were an incredible team, a well oiled machine who kept you at ease and honestly came away from the class with a real excitement about being able to confidently make pasta at home. We absolutely loved the atmosphere, the fun music played whilst we were making the pasta and then stopping for a demonstration so we could follow the steps easily. I can’t say enough good things about this class! And the food, omg. Best thing we ate in Rome! We were so privileged also to be there when Emanuele’s brand new book arrived, so of course we had to buy it and get an autograph. Thank you Emanuele & team for a fantastic day!
Absolutely amazing experience!! Emanuele was an incredibly charming host and provided the best pasta making session ever! Definitely recommend trying it out if in Rome.

What a great experience! Our diverse group quickly became friends. Emmanuel provided a beautiful and clean environment and was a fun and encouraging teacher. The food was delicious! So much fun and a great break from museums and sightseeing.

What a fantastic way to spend a few hours in Roma. You’ll learn a new skill, maybe make some news friends and enjoy a great time.

Emanuele is a great host, who puts everyone at their ease and makes the class enjoyable and relaxed as well as educational.

An amazing night! I only had 2 nights in Rome on my trip and I’m very glad I chose to do this. Emanuele is a great teacher! His demonstrations, instructions and personal help and hints meant I was successful in making delicious pasta. And all in a beautiful Osteria. Definitely worth it.

It was a great evening, with a super nice host. Very entertaining, fun and fun. We enjoyed it a lot, the pasta was super delicious and the mood was great.
The new training room is beautiful.
Thanks for the nice evening

the best last experience at Rome!
totally worth it! Emanuele & Angelo are excellent at teaching pasta techniques. They made everything seem easy, meanwhile you are becoming a pasta expert! Thank you very much guys!!
I totally recommend it!

What a fantastic experience this is. We would do it all again. They are a fantastic team full of energy, passion and great attention to detail. We would highly recommend this experience to everyone. It is located in a stunning old Osteria.

Wonderful pasta making experience. Emanuele and Angelo were very knowledgeable and welcoming. They had great technique and storytelling. This is probably the highlight of our trip in Rome and we would absolutely suggest this to family and friends coming to Rome! In the meantime, we cannot wait to share our pasta making skills and stories back home. 10/10

Hands down this class is the absolute best event in Rome!! Chef Emanuel & Chef Angelo, in their stunning kitchen & dining space, are knowledgeable, fun & hands on. You will learn how to make the best quality pasta, have a delicious meal and enjoy some great music and wine!!

The whole experience was fantastic, starting from the chefs, which gave personal experience and guidance, to the cleaness of the place, the top products, and the amazing food.
I highly recommend

This workshop with Emanuele is absolutely a MUST DO! We really valued his flexibility, accommodating nature and ultra friendly attitude. We arranged this class in advance for our 80 year old grandpa and he LOVED it! Emanuele went over and beyond to make his experience truly memorable. He was patient in explaining, smiley, and very helpful. Our grandpa still talks about the class and shows everyone photos/videos. Thank you Emanuele for all your kindness and making his Rome experience one-of-a-kind. :)

Very joyfull experience. Hosts very friendly and funny and good ecplicators as well. Very efficient assistent. Stylish location. Really learned how to make pasta, without machines All By hand. Very well done guys.

Best experience in Rome! It was amazing to be with Angelo and Emanuelle, they were fantastic hosts! Loved every minute, the playlist chosen for the class was perfect! I've finished my pasta ready to make pasta in my home! I recommend everyone do it!

Amazing hands on experience. since the beginning both changes set the mood of the experience ( not just a class) to be really welcoming. the Studio or place is elegant and appropriate for the experience . The instructions are clear and well prepared. They make it so easy for everyone and everyone was so open to interact and share experience. Learning the process was really good and then eating it. Love the experience from beginning to the end

How to describe in few words such an amazing experience.. So much knowledge , you are a better person after this experience! Literally you will make the best pasta you have ever eaten! The hosts are so nice and genuine, great ambiance , music, such a unique atmosphere and place . Professional work space, very neat. Best food experience ever!

The best pasta we had in Rome we made ourselves thanks to Emanuele and Angelo! This was a wonderful experience, and we learned how to make 5 different pasta shapes and then eat it! Emanuele and Angelo are amazing teachers, they have a great sense of humour and make the whole experience very fun and easy to follow. Great for couples, friends, or solo! Small groups, and a beautiful historic location make this experience unforgettable. This is a must-do for anyone travelling to Rome! Grazie mille!!

Outstanding experience! As someone who is gluten free, Emanuele did everything to tailor the class to my needs. Pasta turned out amazing and Emanuele and his team made the class extra fun with the inclusion of Prosecco, wine, and music!

Just exceptional! Starting from the place, set up, music and utensils. Everything is amazing! you'll learn how to make pasta from scratch, different shapes, filling and sauces. Emmanuele and Angelo are outstanding people and extremely good explaining how to do things. They even prepare a gluten free pasta for one of the participants! Thanks both for every detail of the experience l, and the warmness that only Italians can make you feel.

Incredible, we were a small group of 6 and we were made and eat our own lasagna and our fettuccini. Emanuele and his team made it is so easy in an incredible old space! Good music, winw and good tiramisu at the end. Grazie Emanuele
Amazing experience! We cooked 4 different types of pasta, it was so much fun! Definitely recommend
Great experience, Emanuele and Angelo were perfect, very thoughtful, very friendly. If you even remotely like cooking, this experience is for you.
Must try
This was an incredible experience! One of my favorite experiences in Rome. Everyone should do this if you can!
One of the best experiences I've ever had during my stay in Italy. Grazie Emanuele!
very good welcome, good explanation, very warm place. I highly recommend this experience.
